title: 常压蒸馏
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/169_常压蒸馏.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/169_常压蒸馏/src.py

points.S2: 意外情况：先停热再报告

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜里的蒸馏装置旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a simple distillation setup inside a fume hood, a round-bottom flask in a heating mantle, a condenser with water hoses and a receiving flask, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第七课：常压蒸馏。

shots.scene: 阿杰把乙醇装满烧瓶，在台面上准备用明火加热
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills a round-bottom flask almost to the neck with alcohol on an open bench next to a gas burner flame, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰装满一瓶酒精，还想用明火。

shots.scene: 冷凝管没接水，接收口用塞子塞死
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a distillation setup with dry disconnected condenser hoses and the outlet of the adapter sealed with a stopper, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 冷凝管没通水，出口还塞死了。

shots.scene: 小研关掉火，叫停阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns off the burner and stops the young male student, pointing to the fume hood.
shots.narration: 小研：停！一步步重新来。

shots.scene: 互溶液体：一个烧杯里看不出两层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beaker holding two fully mixed liquids as one clear phase, a separatory funnel crossed out beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 互溶的液体，分液漏斗分不开。

shots.scene: 低沸点先变成蒸气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heated flask with small molecules rising as vapor and larger molecules staying in the liquid, a low and a high temperature icon. No text.
shots.narration: 加热时，沸点低的先变成蒸气。

shots.scene: 蒸气冷凝成液体流入接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: vapor traveling through a cooled tube, turning back into droplets that drip into a receiving flask. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸气遇冷变回液体，流进接收瓶。

shots.scene: 也能除去不挥发杂质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear liquid distilled away from a colored nonvolatile residue left in the flask. No text.
shots.narration: 还能把液体和不挥发杂质分开。

shots.scene: 沸点差大、沸点不高：简单蒸馏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two liquids with far-apart boiling point icons on a scale, a simple distillation setup with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 沸点差得远、不太高，用简单蒸馏。

shots.scene: 沸点接近：分馏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two close boiling point icons on a scale, a fractionating column icon beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 沸点很接近，要用分馏。

shots.scene: 沸点高或受热易分解：减压蒸馏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a high temperature icon and a cracking molecule, a vacuum gauge icon pointing to a reduced pressure setup. No text.
shots.narration: 沸点高或怕热，用减压蒸馏。

shots.scene: 器材一字排开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: laid out on a bench, a round-bottom flask, a three-way distillation head, a temperature probe with adapter, a condenser, a bent adapter and receiving flasks. No text.
shots.narration: 烧瓶、蒸馏头、温度计、冷凝管。

shots.scene: 热源、铁架台、夹子、水管和备用接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heating mantle with a power controller, two stands, clamps, joint clips, hose clamps and rubber tubing laid out. No text.
shots.narration: 热源、铁架台、夹子，多备几只接收瓶。

shots.scene: 装液在三分之一到三分之二之间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round-bottom flask with marks at one third and two thirds, liquid level between them with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 装液在三分之一到三分之二之间。

shots.scene: 太满冲料，太少损失多
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overfilled flask boiling over, liquid splashing into the condenser and receiver, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太满会冲料，太少损失多。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷液里放入搅拌子或两三粒沸石
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands add a magnetic stir bar and two or three boiling chips into a flask of cold water at room temperature.
shots.narration: 加热前，放入搅拌子或几粒沸石。

shots.scene: 气泡均匀冒出，不暴沸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: many small steady bubbles rising from boiling chips, a sudden violent bump crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 它们让气泡均匀冒，防止暴沸。

shots.scene: 向热液里加沸石，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand dropping a boiling chip into a hot liquid near boiling, liquid erupting, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 千万别往热液里补加沸石。

shots.scene: 忘加：停热、冷却再补加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heat off icon, a cooling clock, then a boiling chip added to the cooled flask with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 忘加了：先停热冷却，再补加。

shots.scene: 易燃液体不用明火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas burner flame under a flask crossed out, a heating mantle, a water bath and an oil bath with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸易燃液体不用明火，用电热套水浴。

shots.scene: 加热套不能比烧瓶小
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small heating mantle under a larger flask crossed out, a matching mantle and a larger mantle filled with sand around the flask checked. No text.
shots.narration: 加热套宁大勿小，空隙可填砂。

shots.scene: 铁圈或升降台托住热源，下方留空间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the heating mantle resting on a lab jack under the clamped flask, an arrow showing it can be lowered away. No text.
shots.narration: 热源下留空间，随时能降下来。

shots.scene: 调压器先归零，电线远离热面和水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power controller dial set to zero, the cord routed away from the hot mantle and the water hoses. No text.
shots.narration: 调压器先归零，电线远离热面和水。

shots.scene: 【实拍】对光转动烧瓶查裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands hold an empty round-bottom flask up to the light and turn it slowly, checking for star cracks and chips.
shots.narration: 先对光查：有星裂缺口的不能用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】夹子夹在烧瓶颈部
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a clamp on a stand tightened gently around the neck of the round-bottom flask sitting in the mantle.
shots.narration: 从烧瓶开始，夹子夹在瓶颈上。

shots.scene: 依次接蒸馏头、冷凝管、接引管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: assembly order arrows from the flask to the distillation head, the side arm to the condenser, then the bent adapter and the receiver. No text.
shots.narration: 依次装蒸馏头、冷凝管、接引管。

shots.scene: 接收瓶放在接引管下，可放冰水浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a receiving flask under the adapter outlet resting in a small ice water bath, a graduated cylinder option beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 接收瓶放稳，易挥发的放冰水浴。

shots.scene: 【实拍】磨口薄涂一圈脂，旋转贴合
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a fingertip spreads a thin band of grease on the upper part of a ground glass joint, then the distillation head is twisted gently into the flask neck.
shots.narration: 磨口薄涂一圈脂，旋一下贴合。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷凝管两端都有支撑
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a second clamp holds the middle of the sloping condenser while the adapter end is secured with a joint clip.
shots.narration: 冷凝管斜着会滑，两端都要撑住。

shots.scene: 会变热的接口不用塑料夹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plastic joint clip at the hot flask joint melting with a cross, a plastic clip at the cool adapter end with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 会发热的接口，不用塑料夹。

shots.scene: 【实拍】温度计球上沿与支管下沿平齐
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the bulb of a glass temperature probe inside the distillation head, its top edge level with the bottom edge of the side arm opening.
shots.narration: 温度计球上沿，平支管口下沿。

shots.scene: 太高读数偏低，太低偏高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one bulb set too high above the side arm with a low reading arrow, one set too low with a high reading arrow, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太高读数偏低，太低偏高，都不准。

shots.scene: 蒸气碰到冷壁变成液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cross section of a condenser, cold water in the outer jacket, vapor in the inner tube turning into droplets on the cold wall. No text.
shots.narration: 冷凝管外套走冷水，蒸气遇冷凝结。

shots.scene: 【实拍】下口进水，上口出水到水槽
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: rubber tubing from the tap pushed onto the lower inlet of the condenser, another tube from the upper outlet led into the sink.
shots.narration: 下口接龙头进水，上口出水进水槽。

shots.scene: 反接夹套灌不满
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a condenser with water entering at the top and leaving at the bottom, an air pocket in the jacket, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 接反了，夹套存气泡，冷却变差。

shots.scene: 【实拍】水管用管箍或扎丝箍紧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands tighten hose clamps on both condenser water tubes, then tug gently to check they hold.
shots.narration: 两根水管都箍紧，拉一拉不脱。

shots.scene: 水流开太大，水管冲脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tap opened fully, a tube bursting off a condenser and spraying water onto a heating mantle, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 水流适中就够，开大会冲脱淹设备。

shots.scene: 【实拍】接引管支口敞开通大气
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger points to the open side vent of the bent adapter near the receiver, nothing blocking it.
shots.narration: 接引管支口要通大气，不能堵。

shots.scene: 全部塞死加热，装置炸裂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fully sealed glass apparatus being heated, pressure arrows building inside and the glass bursting, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 全塞死再加热，压力憋高会炸裂。

shots.scene: 整套装置放在通风柜里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the whole distillation setup inside a fume hood with the sash lowered to the marked height, a person standing outside. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸有机溶剂，装置放进通风柜。

shots.scene: 附近无明火、火花，插头远离溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: around the hood, a lit match, a sparking plug and a solvent bottle near a socket, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 附近无明火火花，插头远离溶剂。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and chemical gloves beside the hood. No text.
shots.narration: 实验服、护目镜、手套穿戴好。

shots.scene: 逐个检查接口和夹子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist icon moving along each joint and clamp of the setup, check marks appearing one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 开始前，每个接口和夹子再查一遍。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先开冷却水，看出水顺畅
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the tap is opened slowly, water filling the condenser jacket and flowing steadily out of the upper tube into the sink.
shots.narration: 先开冷却水，看出水顺畅。

shots.scene: 搅拌从慢速开始，最后才开加热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stirrer dial turned from low upward, the stir bar spinning smoothly without jumping. No text.
shots.narration: 搅拌从慢速开始，最后才加热。

shots.scene: 中等加热，平稳沸腾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the power controller turned to a middle setting, the flask boiling gently and evenly. No text.
shots.narration: 加热开到中等，液体平稳沸腾。

shots.scene: 冷凝环升到温度计，读数跳升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: vapor reaching the bulb of the temperature probe, the reading arrow jumping up, droplets entering the condenser. No text.
shots.narration: 冷凝环升到温度计，读数跳上来。

shots.scene: 环停住不动，稍调高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the condensing ring stalled below the side arm, the controller dial nudged up a little. No text.
shots.narration: 冷凝环停住不升，稍微调高一点。

shots.scene: 剧烈翻腾就调低或降下热源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: violently boiling liquid in the flask, the controller turned down and the mantle lowered away. No text.
shots.narration: 翻腾过猛，就调低或降下热源。

shots.scene: 最初几滴单独接，弃去
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the first few drops collected into a small separate flask marked as fore-run, then the receiver swapped. No text.
shots.narration: 最初几滴含低沸点杂质，单独接。

shots.scene: 换大接收瓶接主馏分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a larger clean receiver collecting the main fraction while the temperature reading stays steady. No text.
shots.narration: 温度稳定后，换瓶接主馏分。

shots.scene: 馏出均匀、稳定、不过快
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: steady evenly spaced drops falling from the adapter tip, a fast stream crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 馏出要均匀稳定，不能过快。

shots.scene: 太快混杂质，太慢费时
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fast stream with impurity icons mixed in, a very slow drip with a long clock, a balanced drip checked. No text.
shots.narration: 太快混进杂质，太慢又费时间。

shots.scene: 温度明显变化就换瓶接后馏分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the temperature reading suddenly dropping or rising, the main receiver swapped for a small one to catch the last drops. No text.
shots.narration: 温度明显升或降，马上换瓶接尾。

shots.scene: 边收集边记录体积和温度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook with a table icon and a graduated cylinder collecting distillate, volume and temperature arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 边收集，边记录体积和温度。

shots.scene: 温度随馏出逐渐升高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a curve of temperature versus volume rising then leveling off. No text.
shots.narration: 低沸点的被蒸走，温度慢慢升高。

shots.scene: 记下主馏分的沸程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the temperature range of the main fraction marked between two lines on the curve, a narrow range with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 记下主馏分的沸程，范围窄就较纯。

shots.scene: 有色混合物蒸出无色馏出液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a red colored mixture left in the flask and a clear colorless distillate in the receiver side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 染料留在瓶里，馏出液清澈无色。

shots.scene: 瓶里留少量液体，绝不蒸干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the flask with a small amount of liquid left at the bottom and a check mark, a dry overheated flask cracking crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶底留少量液体，绝不蒸干。

shots.scene: 醚类蒸干，过氧化物浓缩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ether flask nearly dry with peroxide crystal icons concentrating in the residue and an explosion icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 醚类蒸干，残留过氧化物可能爆炸。

shots.scene: 先关热源，降下加热套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the controller turned to zero and the heating mantle lowered away from the flask. No text.
shots.narration: 停蒸馏：先关热源，降下加热套。

shots.scene: 冷凝水开着，冷了再关水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water still running through the condenser while the flask cools with a clock, then the tap closed. No text.
shots.narration: 冷凝水继续开，瓶凉了再关水。

shots.scene: 先关水，蒸气从接口冲出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the water turned off while the flask is still hot, vapor escaping from the joints, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 先关水，热蒸气会从接口冒出。

shots.scene: 冷了再拆，热玻璃别摸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand in a heat resistant glove waiting by the cooling setup, then taking it apart in reverse order. No text.
shots.narration: 冷了再按相反顺序拆，热玻璃别摸。

shots.scene: 馏出液贴标签存放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capped receiving flask with a blank label placed in a tray, a product icon. No text.
shots.narration: 馏出液盖好，贴标签存放。

shots.scene: 前馏分、残液进指定废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fore-run and the flask residue poured into labeled organic waste containers, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 前馏分和残液进指定废液桶。

shots.section_title: 意外情况：先停热再报告
shots.scene: 冲料、漏水、着火：先关热源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a boil over, a leaking hose and a small flame, all followed by a heat off icon. No text.
shots.narration: 冲料漏水或着火，先关热源。
overlay: 意外情况：先停热再报告

shots.section_title: 意外情况：先停热再报告
shots.scene: 小火盖灭或用灭火器，大火撤离报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small flame in the hood covered or put out with an extinguisher, a bigger fire with people leaving and a phone icon. No text.
shots.narration: 小火按培训扑救，火大撤离打119。

shots.section_title: 意外情况：先停热再报告
shots.scene: 报告实验室负责人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports the incident to the older man at the lab door, the young male student standing beside them.
shots.narration: 处理后，及时报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 装液适量，冷时加沸石
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask filled between one third and two thirds with boiling chips added to cold liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 装液适量，沸石搅拌子冷时加。

shots.scene: 温度计位置、下进上出、通大气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the bulb level with the side arm, condenser water entering low and leaving high, an open vent at the adapter. No text.
shots.narration: 温度计对准支管，下进上出通大气。

shots.scene: 无明火，平稳馏出，不蒸干，先停热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electric mantle without flame, steady drops, liquid left in the flask, heat off before water off. No text.
shots.narration: 不用明火，均匀馏出，不蒸干。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在分馏柱和旋转蒸发仪旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fractionating column setup and a rotary evaporator, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：分馏、减压蒸馏与回流。
